thread:
Ravi Patel: Quick ask — we need a stripped down battlecard for SDRs after the Redwood benchmarks webinar. Focus: 30s pitch, 2 rebut bullets per competitor (CloudHarbor, PromptFlow, ScaleMesh), and a short inbound routing table. Can @Sofia take the draft? :calendar:

Sofia Morales: Yep I can. Want the benchmark callouts included (latency + $/1k tokens) + one-sentence "why Redwood" and 2 pushback lines. Also will we mention private deployment?

Dana Kim: Include private option yes. Benchmarks safe-to-share: p50 Redwood 95ms vs CloudHarbor 290ms; cost $0.55 vs $1.70 per 1k tokens on our summarization suite. Use cautious language: "internal tests" and link to console for details.

Dana Kim: ```Bench (safe-to-share): Redwood p50 95ms, $0.55/1k tokens. CloudHarbor p50 290ms, $1.70/1k. Test: summarization-1k, 10-clients.```

Owen Blake: For PromptFlow callout: they push breadth of models + marketplace. Rebut bullets: rollout controls limited, and observability is coarse. For ScaleMesh: they scale raw GPU pools — rebut: poor cost controls and no KV prefix caching.

Sofia Morales: Draft outline I'll post: 1) 30s opener 2) Bench snippet 3) When to pick Redwood 4) 2 rebut bullets each 5) Routing rules 6) Webinar follow-up email snippet. Keep each line <20 words.

Ravi Patel: Routing rules should map keywords to teams (SLA->Enterprise AE, POC->Solutions Eng, OSS/self-host->Growth). Also add a short webhook flag for inbound leads that mention "benchmarks" so we can attach benchmark PDF.

marketing-bot: Action created: attach-bench-pdf webhook will tag leads with 'bench' if message contains "benchmark" or "p50". Meeting: Quick review 10m Wed 09:30 PT.

Owen Blake: Email follow-up snippet idea:

Sofia Morales: ```Hey {{first_name}}, thanks for attending — we measured Redwood at ~95ms p50 vs competitors. Watch a 90s demo + request a pilot: <link>. Want a trial run?```

Dana Kim: Also suggest a 2-line social post for launch thread: "New webinar: see latency & cost wins vs CloudHarbor + how rollout controls reduce risk in production. Replay + one-pager -> <link>" Keep it punchy.

Sofia Morales: I'll post the one-pager draft here by Tue 5pm. Please drop edits inline. Need final by Wed EOD so SDRs can use for Thurs follow-up. :pray:
